user.title: Barco cinema projector
user.description: Enter the IP address of the projector controller. The control port is 43728 for series 2 projectors (DP2K, DP4K) and 43680 for series 1 (DP90, DP100, DP1200, DP1500, DP2000, DP3000).

data_description.media_block: Choose ICMP when a Barco ICMP or ICMP-X is installed and you want player control as well.

media_block.title: ICMP automation
media_block.description: The ICMP automation server listens on TCP 43748, reachable through the projector network interface or one of the ICMP LAN ports. Leave the host empty to use the projector address.

error.cannot_connect: The projector did not answer on this address and port.
error.cannot_connect_icmp: The ICMP automation server did not answer on this address and port.

data_description.scan_interval_seconds: The Barco protocol is blocking, so keep this at 10 seconds or more.
data_description.media_block_host: Leave empty to use the projector address.

execute_macro.name: Execute macro
execute_macro.description: Executes a macro (preset) stored on the projector.

macro.name: Macro
macro.description: The name of the macro, exactly as stored on the projector.

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Sends an arbitrary Barco command. Framing, escaping and the checksum are handled for you.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command bytes as hex, for example 76 9a.

send_automation.name: Send automation command
send_automation.description: Sends a raw Automation over IP command to the ICMP.

command.name: Command
command.description: For example PLAYER.Pause (seconds),10 - the trailing semicolon is added automatically.

gpio_pulse.name: Pulse GPIO output
gpio_pulse.description: Pulses one of the ICMP GPIO outputs.

gpio_set.name: Set GPIO outputs
gpio_set.description: Sets one or more ICMP GPIO outputs.
